description: SEC filing-review correspondence: form UPLOAD (SEC's letter) and CORRESP (the company's reply), released ~20+ business days after a review closes; 2005 on. Text: filing_index_url. since/until (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive) and the sort use date_filed, the letter's date; released_date exists only on records from EDGAR's daily indexes. A comment letter is ROUTINE, not an accusation: most large filers are reviewed on a cycle (Sarbanes-Oxley §408: at least every 3 years). More: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_sec_comment_letters
name: get_sec_comment_letters
